notes.title: Gobs of Glory v 0.2.5 now live!
notes.notes:
Real life is really getting in the way of development but I managed to do a few things worth updating.

New features and bug fixes in 0.2.5:

[list]
[*]Chat action in combat  that breaks stealth
[*]Spells with verbal components break stealth
[*]Overhead chat messages slowed down a bit
[*]Combat waiting room chat with timeout implemented
[*]Fixed some display bugs in waiting room
[/list]

notes.title: v 0.2.4
notes.notes:
- Improved NPC AI a bit, made goblins much easier in solo/coop matches
- fixed some overhead display bugs
- moved all the arena maps to their location in the persistent open world, fixed a bunch of bugs related to this movement
- upgraded the existing arenas a bit, fixed god mode teleport
- clockwork toy bugs fixed, some random crashes fixed
- changed map builder to invite only given it's current fragile in-development state. Want to really focus on combat, arenas and leaderboards in the upcoming playtest and initial release
